verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an agent product, so the axis applies. The docs describe dots as a cloud-hosted ChatGPT agent that 'lives in the cloud and has its own computer'. Connecting a local computer only exposes local files and apps to the cloud agent; it is not running the core product yourself, and no self-hosted deployment is documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
